mapper.select: SELECT e.EMP_NO AS empNo, e.EMP_NM AS empNm, e.EMP_ENG_NM AS empEngNm, e.EML_ADDR AS emlAddr, e.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, d.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, e.JBGD_CD AS jbgdCd, p.JBGD_NM AS jbgdNm, e.EMPL_SE_CD AS emplSeCd, e.EMP_STTS_CD AS empSttsCd, e.JNCMP_YMD AS jncmpYmd, e.RETIR_YMD AS retirYmd, e.RSDNT_NO AS rsdntNo, e.BRDT AS brdt, e.SEXDSTN_CD AS sexdstnCd, e.MBTLNUM AS mbtlnum, e.ADDR AS addr, e.ZIP_CD AS zipCd, e.ADDR_DTL AS addrDtl, e.BANK_CD AS bankCd, e.ACTNO AS actno, e.EMRGNC_CNTCT_NM AS emrgncCntctNm, e.EMRGNC_TELNO AS emrgncTelno, e.FILE_REF_ID AS fileRefId, e.REGIST_DT AS registDt, e.UPDT_DT AS updtDt FROM hrm_emp_master e LEFT JOIN hrm_dept_master d ON e.DEPT_CD = d.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN hrm_pos_master p ON e.JBGD_CD = p.JBGD_CD WHERE e.EMP_NO = #{empNo}
SELECT IFNULL( MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(EMP_NO, '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0 ) + 1 FROM hrm_emp_master WHERE EMP_NO LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '-%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hrm_emp_master ( EMP_NO, EMP_NM, EMP_ENG_NM, EML_ADDR, DEPT_CD, JBGD_CD, EMPL_SE_CD, EMP_STTS_CD, JNCMP_YMD, RETIR_YMD, RSDNT_NO, BRDT, SEXDSTN_CD, MBTLNUM, ADDR, ZIP_CD, ADDR_DTL, BANK_CD, ACTNO, EMRGNC_CNTCT_NM, EMRGNC_TELNO, FILE_REF_ID ) VALUES ( #{empNo}, #{empNm}, #{empEngNm}, #{emlAddr}, #{deptCd}, #{jbgdCd}, #{emplSeCd}, #{empSttsCd}, #{jncmpYmd}, #{retirYmd}, #{rsdntNo}, #{brdt}, #{sexdstnCd}, #{mbtlnum}, #{addr}, #{zipCd}, #{addrDtl}, #{bankCd}, #{actno}, #{emrgncCntctNm}, #{emrgncTelno}, #{fileRefId} )
mapper.select: SELECT DEPT_CD AS deptCd, DEPT_NM AS deptNm, DEPT_ORDR AS deptOrdr FROM hrm_dept_master ORDER BY DEPT_ORDR
SELECT JBGD_CD AS jbgdCd, JBGD_NM AS jbgdNm, JBGD_ORDR AS jbgdOrdr FROM hrm_pos_master ORDER BY JBGD_ORDR
